query:
UPDATE episode
        SET
            episode_number = $2,
            season_number = $3,
            title = $4,
            title_japanese = $5,
            title_romaji = $6,
            synopsis = $7,
            description = $8,
            aired_at = $9,
            duration_seconds = $10,
            is_filler = $11,
            is_recap = $12,
            score = $13::float8::numeric(5, 2),
            version = $14,
            merged_record_hash = $15,
            hash_format = $16,
            merge_version = $17,
            merge_requested_at = NULL,
            merged_at = COALESCE(merged_at, $18),
            updated_at = $18
        WHERE id = $1
